title: External data sharing
content: External sharing of customer data is prohibited.

title: External data sharing
content: External sharing is permitted only with approved vendors.

title: Vendor-X exception for Dataset Y
content: Vendor-X is not approved for Dataset Y.

title: Customer record retention
content: Customer support records may be retained for 5 years.

title: Customer record retention in the EU
content: Customer support records may be retained for 2 years.

title: Additional EU dataset restrictions
content: Additional restrictions apply to certain customer datasets.

title: Personal device access
content: Company data may not be accessed from personal laptops or phones.

title: Personal device access
content: Company data may be accessed from a personal laptop only if it is enrolled in device management and disk encryption is on.

title: Personal device access for Engineering in India
content: Engineering staff in India must use a company-issued laptop for production systems. Personal devices are not permitted.

title: Working remotely
content: Staff may work remotely up to three days a week with manager approval.

title: Working remotely in the EU
content: Staff in the EU may work fully remotely. Cross-border remote work beyond 30 days a year needs HR approval.

title: Public wifi use
content: Company systems must not be accessed over public wifi without the corporate VPN.

title: Encryption of customer data
content: Customer data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

title: Handling personal information
content: Personal information must be masked in logs, dashboards and support tickets.

title: Personal information in the EU
content: Personal information belonging to EU residents may not leave the EU region without a transfer agreement.

title: Data classification levels
content: Data is classified Public, Internal, Confidential or Restricted. Restricted data requires named approval for every access.

title: Backups
content: Production databases must be backed up daily and restores tested every quarter.

title: System log retention
content: Application and access logs are retained for 90 days.

title: Financial record retention
content: Invoices and financial records must be retained for 7 years.

title: Getting a vendor approved
content: A vendor must pass a security review before any data is shared. Approval lasts twelve months.

title: Vendor-Z exception for EU Support
content: Vendor-Z is approved for EU Support ticket data only, and not for billing data.

title: Vendor subprocessors
content: An approved vendor may not pass company data to its own subcontractors without written consent.

title: Who can sign a contract
content: Only Legal may sign contracts on behalf of the company. Other teams must route agreements through Legal.

title: Access to production systems
content: Production access is granted on request, expires after 30 days, and is reviewed quarterly.

title: Administrator access
content: Administrator rights on production require two approvals and are granted for a maximum of 24 hours.

title: Multi-factor authentication
content: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all company accounts.

title: Passwords
content: Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Routine expiry is no longer required.

title: Leaver access removal
content: All access must be revoked within 24 hours of a person leaving the company.

title: Reporting a security incident
content: A suspected security incident must be reported to the security team within one hour.

title: Breach notification in the EU
content: A personal data breach affecting EU residents must be reported to the regulator within 72 hours.

title: Using external AI tools
content: Customer data and source code must not be pasted into external AI tools that are not on the approved list.

title: Open source licences
content: Copyleft licensed code may not be used in the product without Legal approval.

title: Business travel
content: Flights under six hours must be economy class. Travel needs manager approval in advance.

title: Expense claims
content: Expenses must be claimed within 60 days with a receipt. Claims over 500 need director approval.

title: Expense claims in India
content: Claims in India must include a GST invoice where the vendor is GST registered.

title: Buying software
content: Any new software purchase over 1000 a year needs a security review and Finance sign-off.

title: Security training
content: Every employee must complete security training once a year.

title: Audit trail
content: Access to Restricted data is logged and the log is kept for two years.

title: Recording meetings
content: Meetings may be recorded only if every participant is told at the start.

title: Recording meetings in the EU
content: In the EU, every participant must give explicit consent before a meeting is recorded.

title: Speaking publicly about the company
content: Unreleased product details must not be posted publicly. Press questions go to Communications.
